title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: which excess withdrawal fee on a certificate funding transfer is refunded, and for how much
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to a Savings & Money Market Accounts account from which the owner funded a certificate of deposit by internal transfer. Once the funding transfer is known, it fixes which fee entry is refunded and the amount.

## Policy clause

1. The fee refunded is the excess withdrawal fee attached to the funding transfer, that is the excess withdrawal fee whose source withdrawal is that transfer.
2. The refund amount is that fee's full posted amount, rounded half-up to the cent.
3. When no excess withdrawal fee is attached to the funding transfer, nothing is refunded under this rule.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The fee entry, the withdrawal it is attached to and its posted amount are read from the savings account's transaction record.
- **Object correlation.** Only a fee attached to the funding transfer itself is refunded; excess withdrawal fees attached to other withdrawals of the same cycle are not.

## Input, judgement, output

| Fee entries on the account | Attached to | Refunded under this rule? |
|---|---|---|
| excess withdrawal fee, USD 8.00 | the funding transfer | yes, USD 8.00 in full |
| excess withdrawal fee, USD 8.00 | an online transfer later in the cycle | no |
| monthly maintenance fee | no withdrawal | no |

(Amounts are hypothetical; USD 8.00 is illustrative, not a tier value.)

## Points of judgement

**No excess withdrawal fee is attached to the funding transfer, but another withdrawal in the same cycle carries one. Is that other fee refunded here?** No; nothing is refunded under this rule when no fee is attached to the funding transfer.

**Can part of the fee be refunded?** No; the refund is the fee's full posted amount.
